name: openmc-studio
description: Lightweight desktop GUI for OpenMC reactor and shielding workflows.

scripts.build: npm --workspace packages/schema run build && npm --workspace apps/desktop run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace packages/schema run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/desktop run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace packages/schema run test && cd services/openmc-worker && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
